Both panels are line plots showing how two methods (as indicated by the legends) change as training progresses; they share the same horizontal axis labeled “Steps,” which appears to use a linear scale with evenly spaced tick marks (the numeric tick labels are not visible in the provided image), spanning from the left edge of the plot area to the right edge. The vertical axis in both panels is unlabeled in the provided image and appears linear, with horizontal gridlines and tick marks present but without readable numeric labels; each method is drawn as a solid line with a semi-transparent shaded band around it.

In the top panel (the “Easy” setting as indicated by the legend entries), there are two solid lines with no point markers: a blue line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” and a red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy,” each accompanied by a translucent band of the same color surrounding the line. Both lines start lower on the left and rise sharply over the early portion of the steps axis, after which they continue with smaller oscillations near the upper part of the y-range; the blue line shows repeated small peaks and dips as it progresses, and the red line follows a similar rising-then-fluctuating pattern, with the two traces running close together for much of the mid-to-late portion of the x-range.

In the bottom panel titled “Hard Training Set,” the blue solid line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” appears only near the far left at a low y-position and then is not visibly present across most of the remaining steps range, while the red solid line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” (with a matching semi-transparent red band) rises from a low starting value on the left, increases quickly early on, and then continues upward more gradually with frequent jagged fluctuations; in the later portion of the steps axis the red line remains in the upper region of the panel and exhibits several local peaks and dips before ending near its highest visible level at the right edge.
